summary: Crimson Desert entries added from the live guide-pack catalogue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Crimson Desert
entries.definitive_edition: Crimson Desert on Windows PC, current patch

emulation.notes: Native Windows route; no emulation branch.

primary.version: Crimson Desert PC (Steam / Epic Games Store)
primary.why: Launched simultaneously on PC and current-gen consoles with no content split, so PC is the fidelity pick: uncapped settings and resolution against fixed console targets. The macOS and GeForce NOW routes exist but are convenience/streaming paths, not fidelity ones.
primary.how_to_play: Play Crimson Desert on Windows PC. Record storefront/build and patch version (a launch-window open-world release changes quickly), graphics preset and upscaler, resolution/aspect, and main-quest progress.
